domain-model.role: Own Java EE entity models, validation constraints, persistence mappings, and model-focused tests under src/main/java/org/agoncal/application/petstore/model, src/main/java/org/agoncal/application/petstore/constraints, src/main/resources/META-INF, and matching src/test/java tests.

service-layer.role: Own CDI/EJB services, ordering, catalog, inventory, shipping, pricing, and service integration tests under src/main/java/org/agoncal/application/petstore/service and related test packages.

rest-api.role: Own JAX-RS endpoints, REST application wiring, Swagger contract, API behavior, and endpoint integration tests under src/main/java/org/agoncal/application/petstore/rest, src/main/webapp/swagger.json, and matching src/test/java tests.

web-ui.role: Own JSF view beans, shopping and admin pages, templates, CSS, localization, and view integration tests under src/main/java/org/agoncal/application/petstore/view, src/main/webapp, and matching src/test/java tests.

build-and-test.role: Own Maven build configuration, WildFly and Arquillian profiles, test execution, packaging, and build/test documentation in pom.xml, src/test/resources, src/main/docker, and README.md.
